verdict.rationale: Cursor's core value proposition is analyzing the user's codebase to surface AI-generated insights (tracing repo structure, finding root causes, reviewing diffs) and suggestions for next actions, as documented across multiple first-party docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence validating the accuracy or depth of these insights, and no detail on insight types beyond code-centric suggestions (e.g., data analytics or business data outside code).
